decision.observation: The climb has stalled on the trunk face with the blue stamina segment shrinking and no gain in altitude, so the palm's smooth trunk gives no purchase.
decision.hypothesis: Climbing works on rock but not on these palm trunks; the intended route is the rock faces toward the mountain. Releasing and moving inland is more productive than draining stamina here.
decision.memory: Palm trunks are not climbable; use the mechanic on rock walls instead.
